hotel_name: Super Hotel O Rohini Sector 20 Mait Formerly Maharaja Grand

positive_snippets:
I recently stayed at this hotel and had a very pleasant experience overall. The room was clean, well-maintained, and comfortably furnished. The bed was especially cozy, and I appreciated the quiet atmosphere which made it easy to relax after a long day.

The staff were professional and courteous, always ready to help with a smile. Check-in and check-out were smooth and efficient. The location was convenient, close to several restaurants and local attractions, which made getting around easy.

One area that could use improvement was the breakfast selection — while decent, it was a bit limited and repetitive. Also, the Wi-Fi connection in the room occasionally dropped, which was a minor inconvenience.

Despite these small drawbacks, I would definitely consider staying here again and recommend it to others looking for a comfortable and reliable place to stay.
